title: Process terminal
what: A terminal card in the middle third of the frame, output arriving line by line. The lines are paced to finish on a word you choose, then the card holds until a later phrase and goes. The face stays visible around it.
when: A sentence describing a process with steps -- raw file in, edit out. Generated rather than captured, so it costs no screen recording. Reference only: it was built for one video and has not been reused yet, so treat it as a starting point rather than a proven look.
seen_in: aieditoradvancing -- 'du bara slänger in din RAW-file och så gör den om den till en edit'

cue.finishBy: the word its output should finish on
